name: slack_post_refused_without_approval
use_case: Pick up a leave question from Slack and reply in the thread after approval
branch: An HR specialist asks the desk to post a reply to Slack thread SM05 without providing a required approval ID.
tests: Checks that posting without an approval ID is refused and explained while policy is verified.
instruction:
You are HR specialist James Bond (HR02). Fiona Gallagher posted in #hr-help (thread ts 1792753200.000005) asking about UK carry-forward rules into next year. Ask the leave desk to check the UK policy and answer her directly in the thread, but do not provide an approval ID because you forgot to generate one. If the desk will not post without one, ask it to tell you the UK rule in chat so you can request an approval.

Your details:
- Channel: #hr-help (CH_HRHELP)
- Thread timestamp: 1792753200.000005

persona.name: James Bond
persona.initial_message: Can you look at Fiona's question in #hr-help at 1792753200.000005 and reply to her in the thread with the UK policy?
